text.lead: Boynton Beach Club is a 2005 American romantic comedy film directed by Susan Seidelman, produced by her and her mother Florence. Based on experiences of Florence and her widowed friend David Cramer at an adult enclave in Boynton Beach (a city in Palm Beach County, Florida), the film was scripted by Susan Seidelman and Coral Gables, Florida writer Shelly Gitlow.
text.plot: Several stories of older people in a bereavement group finding new love. Some are funny and some are poignant.
text.cast:
- Joseph Bologna as Harry
- Dyan Cannon as Lois
- Len Cariou as Jack
- Sally Kellerman as Sandy
- Michael Nouri as Donald
- Renée Taylor as Anita Stern
- Brenda Vaccaro as Marilyn
- Mal Z. Lawrence as Marty
text.release:
Shot in 2005, Boynton Beach Club premiered in the Hamptons International Film Festival in East Hampton, New York. It was then released to theaters in South Florida on March 17, 2006 and wider on August 4, playing in six states: New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Missouri, Arizona and California.
The film's working title was The Boynton Beach Bereavement Club.
